reasons.plausibility: Replacing Ta with Nb to reduce density while retaining a similar BCC solid-solution and high-temperature performance is consistent with established principles in high-entropy alloy design and is scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: They give a clear procedure to make and test the new alloy (HfMoNbTiZr) against the baseline, including density and mechanical property measurements under the same conditions, which could definitively refute or support the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The proposed substitution is a straightforward, well-motivated strategy to address the research question, offering a clear path forward for experimentally reducing density while preserving strength.
